facts.fact: Janu's unfinished leopard story ends: the leopard, driven from the village, comes back to the hill's edge every night; they keep the door and a lamp open and she walks in. Devan stopped the stories because he was not sure Neela was ready to hear that ending.
facts.why: needed because the outline has Janu finish the leopard story with the leopard coming home.

facts.fact: Neela's sleeping/lying breath has a small catch at the ninth count of a long breath; Devan's is at the third part of his. Neela counts his hitch every morning as proof he is still there.
facts.why: needed for the breathing-hitch beat; it extends the established hitch (F083, F165).

facts.fact: The wound-share carries pleasure as a warmth as well as hurt, on a night they are together.
facts.why: needed for the intimate scene; it extends the wound-share to sensation without breaking the rule.

facts.fact: Forty riders on borrowed horses wait in the road below the padippura at dawn; Bhaskaran's horn (one long, two short) announces them.
facts.why: needed for the closing beat and chapter 32's departure.
